content:
The image shows a mango leaf with:
- Irregular, dark brown necrotic lesions on the upper leaf surface
- Lesions with a roughly circular to irregular shape, slightly sunken appearance
- Brown/tan coloration with darker borders
- No white powdery coating (rules out Powdery Mildew)
- No black sooty coating (rules out Sooty Mould)
- No tip/shoot dieback pattern (rules out Die Back)
- The lesion pattern — discrete, dark, irregular spots with necrotic tissue — is characteristic of Anthracnose (*Colletotrichum gloeosporioides*), which causes irregular brown-black lesions on mango leaves
